name: blacksmith
description: The Blacksmith factory as Claude Code plugins: the /bs operator console and the role contracts it dispatches, plus bs-mod, an optional live HUD.

plugins.name: blacksmith
plugins.description: The Blacksmith operator console: /bs plans an epic, drives a wave of agents through TDD, review and a merge queue, and audits a project on four axes. Needs the smith CLI from npm (@juzser/blacksmith).

plugins.name: bs-mod
plugins.description: Optional live HUD for Blacksmith: a band above the prompt shows the session's epic, wave, agents, budget and what waits on you, with a /bs-mod pane and toasts. A plugin module; needs a Claude Code build with plugin modules.
